mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary policy, which typically leads to a decrease in liquidity and a rise in borrowing costs, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates weakening labor market conditions, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp.

mechanism_narrative: A significant drop in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) suggests a weakening demand, which can lead to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS drops significantly.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals strengthening supply-side conditions, which can lead to increased corporate earnings and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO increases > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising unemployment (UNRATE) and falling nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates a weakening labor market, which can lead to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and PAYEMS falls > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both UNRATE and PAYEMS meet the trigger conditions.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases > 2% YoY.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing market, which can lead to increased economic activity and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases > 10% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of rising real GDP (GDPC1) and falling unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates a strengthening economy, which can lead to increased consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% YoY and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp in 3 months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when both GDPC1 and UNRATE meet the trigger conditions.
